icons.name: heading
icons.heading: Heading
icons.description: The block becomes a level-1 heading: the H grows to heading size and the level is written beside it. Strong: the H gathers first (a small dip), swells to 1.2x with a rebound and a second smaller swell; the 1 writes itself in and pops as its stem lands.

icons.name: paragraph
icons.heading: Paragraph
icons.description: A paragraph break is set, like a carriage return: the pilcrow's two stems run down from the foot of the bowl to the baseline in turn, and the mark takes their landing. Strong: the stems visibly roll up to the bowl first, then drop harder in turn; the mark squashes deeper, rebounds and settles.
